nodes.label: Research Centre for Asset Performance
nodes.rationale: Dedicated hub for predictive maintenance, reliability engineering, and performance optimisation of industrial assets, powered by Siemens Xcelerator.

nodes.label: TANSAM Internship Program
nodes.rationale: Industry-oriented internship programs in Industry 4.0 technologies to equip students with practical skills aligned with industry requirements.

nodes.label: Industrial IoT & Edge Computing
nodes.rationale: Sensors and edge devices make legacy equipment smart, enabling real-time monitoring, reduced latency, and faster decision-making.

nodes.label: Innovative Manufacturing Lab
nodes.rationale: Hub for reverse engineering, additive manufacturing, and 3D printing powered by Siemens Xcelerator to accelerate product innovation and reduce costs.

nodes.label: Centre for Predictive Engineering Analytics
nodes.rationale: Empowers MSMEs, startups, and students to design, test, and validate products virtually before manufacturing, reducing costs and accelerating innovation.

nodes.label: Product Innovation Center
nodes.rationale: Hub for design thinking, prototyping, and product development to transform ideas into market-ready solutions using Siemens Xcelerator, CAD/CAE tools, and rapid prototyping.

nodes.label: PLM Solutions (Siemens Teamcenter)
nodes.rationale: Powered by Siemens Teamcenter to manage products from concept to retirement with digital continuity, collaboration, and efficiency.

nodes.label: Smart Factory Center
nodes.rationale: Enables adoption of Industry 4.0 technologies via Siemens Xcelerator automation, IoT, robotics, and digital twin platforms to modernize operations.

nodes.label: TANSAM Organization
nodes.rationale: Industry Centre of Excellence powered by Siemens, set up with TIDCO to bridge academia and industry, create jobs, and strengthen Tamil Nadu's industrial ecosystem.
